content: I just checked my credit card statement and I was charged TWICE for my subscription. $29 twice on the same day. This is ridiculous, I want an immediate refund.

I completely understand your concern, and I apologize for this billing error. Double charges are definitely not acceptable. Let me look into your account right away to verify this and get it resolved.
This better be fixed fast. I've been a loyal customer for over a year and this is how I'm treated? I'm already considering switching to another platform.

I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, and I appreciate your loyalty as a 14-month customer. I can see both charges on your account - one was processed at 12:01 AM and another at 12:03 AM due to a system glitch during our payment processing update. I'm issuing a full refund for the duplicate charge right now. You should see the $29 credited back to your card within 5-7 business days.
Fine. But what about the hassle this caused? I spent 20 minutes on hold before getting through to you.

You're absolutely right, and I apologize for the wait time. As a gesture of goodwill for the inconvenience, I'm also adding a $10 credit to your account that you can use toward your next billing cycle. I've also flagged this incident with our billing team to ensure the processing glitch doesn't affect other customers.
Okay, I appreciate that. The refund and the credit. Just make sure this doesn't happen again.
Absolutely. I've documented everything and our billing team is already working on a fix. Your refund reference number is REF-2024-78432. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you for handling this.
You're welcome! Thank you for your patience and for being a valued customer. If you have any other concerns, don't hesitate to reach out. Have a great day!
